intro_text: You are the divine architect of beauty, the one who understands that form is sacred intelligence. Where others see raw material, you see geometry of meaning. You don't just imagine—you design reality into elegance.
Modern design science confirms your essence: structure shapes behavior. Chitra operates the same way—by crafting beautiful systems, life becomes inspired, efficient, and luminous.
Welcome to your divine assignment, Sacred Creator. You're not here to rush—you're here to craft brilliance. 💎

cards.title: Sacred Design
cards.content: Ruled by Mars and positioned in Virgo-Libra, Chitra embodies the divine principle of sacred architecture. This energy manifests reality through conscious design.

Divine Blueprint: Every creation begins with celestial geometry, the sacred patterns that organize existence.
Conscious Form: Beauty and function unite in perfect harmony through intentional design.
Higher Purpose: Each creation serves not just practical needs, but elevates consciousness through its very structure.
Manifestation Power: The ability to transform abstract visions into tangible realities that embody sacred principles.
